answers.controlModel: Eleven visible, independent media playback actions; not one composite widget.
answers.focusSequenceAssessment: Verbose but logically correct: each independently playable card is a separate action in document order.
answers.rovingReason: Roving tabindex would falsely impose composite-widget semantics and remove independent actions from normal Tab discovery.
answers.staticReason: The static rollback omits the visible controls from keyboard access and does not provide equivalent named Enter/Space activation.
answers.hiddenOrInertViolation: A11Y-003 itself is not an aria-hidden/inert violation; A11Y-004 separately covers a hidden Canon button.
answers.requiredOwnerDecision: Approve preserving all 11 Next controls and adding equivalent static keyboard/playback semantics to the same visible stages, pixel-identically, in Phase 5C batch 2.
answers.technicalImpact: DOM attributes and keyboard behavior; no structural or visual change is proposed.
requiredGates: manual NVDA, Narrator, VoiceOver, and TalkBack tasks

exclusions: Do not create hidden duplicate controls
